android.ble_lost.note: Set up a new device (over Bluetooth): error given to the setup page when the Bluetooth link dropped while a request was sent; the app reconnects.

android.ble_send_failed.text: Could not send to the device
android.ble_send_failed.note: Set up a new device (over Bluetooth): error given to the setup page when a request couldn't be written over Bluetooth.

android.bluetooth_needed_hint.text: Allow nearby devices for Off The Cloud in Settings to set a device up this way.
android.bluetooth_needed_hint.note: Set up a new device (over Bluetooth): under the heading Bluetooth access is needed. "Nearby devices" is Android's name for the Bluetooth permission and Settings the phone's Settings app: use Android's own words in this language.

android.bluetooth_off_hint.text: Turn Bluetooth on to find the device.
android.bluetooth_off_hint.note: Set up a new device (over Bluetooth): under the heading Bluetooth is off.

android.cache_bytes.note: Settings > Thumbnail cache: a size below one kilobyte (Using 0 bytes of 1 GB for an empty cache); larger sizes use the units KB, MB, GB.

android.download_changed.text: the file changed on the device while downloading
android.download_changed.note: Why opening or downloading a file failed, after Download failed: or similar (hence the lowercase start): the file was replaced on the device while it was being fetched.

android.download_empty_piece.text: the device sent an empty piece of the file
android.download_empty_piece.note: Why opening or downloading a file failed, after Download failed: or similar (hence the lowercase start): the device sent a piece without data before the end of the file.

android.download_wrong_piece.text: the device sent the wrong piece of the file
android.download_wrong_piece.note: Why opening or downloading a file failed, after Download failed: or similar (hence the lowercase start): a piece the device sent doesn't match the place asked for.

android.menu_sections.note: Screen-reader name of the left menu and of the icon rail (on a wide screen), not shown.

android.notification_channel.note: Name of the notification channel for pushes, shown in Android's notification settings for the app.

android.notification_channel_description.text: Friend requests, new posts, likes and comments
android.notification_channel_description.note: Description of that notification channel, shown under its name in Android's notification settings.

android.signal_good.note: Set up a new device (over Bluetooth): at the right of a device in the list of devices waiting to be set up: its Bluetooth signal is good.

android.signal_strong.note: Set up a new device (over Bluetooth): at the right of a device in the list of devices waiting to be set up: its Bluetooth signal is strong (it is probably the closest).

android.signal_weak.note: Set up a new device (over Bluetooth): at the right of a device in the list of devices waiting to be set up: its Bluetooth signal is weak.

android.storage_gauge.note: Screen-reader name of the storage ring in the icon rail (on a wide screen) while the device's status isn't known yet; pressing it opens the whole menu at the storage details.

android.storage_gauge_attention.note: Screen-reader name of the storage ring in the icon rail (on a wide screen) while the device's fullness isn't known and a disk stopped working or the device reports a problem; pressing it opens the whole menu at the storage details.

android.storage_gauge_used.note: Screen-reader name of the storage ring in the icon rail (on a wide screen); pressing it opens the whole menu at the storage details. {percent} is how full the storage is, already formatted (45%).

android.storage_gauge_used_attention.text: Storage, {percent} used, needs attention. Show details
android.storage_gauge_used_attention.note: Screen-reader name of the storage ring in the icon rail (on a wide screen) when a disk stopped working or the device reports a problem. {percent} is how full the storage is, already formatted (45%).

android.storage_hide_details.note: Screen-reader name of the Storage row at the foot of the left menu (on a wide screen) while the storage details under it are shown: pressing it hides them.

android.storage_hide_details_attention.note: Screen-reader name of the Storage row at the foot of the left menu (on a wide screen) while the storage details are shown and a disk stopped working or the device reports a problem: pressing it hides them.

android.storage_show_details.note: Screen-reader name of the Storage row at the foot of the left menu (on a wide screen) while the storage details under it are hidden: pressing it shows them.

android.storage_show_details_attention.note: Screen-reader name of the Storage row at the foot of the left menu (on a wide screen) while the storage details are hidden and a disk stopped working or the device reports a problem: pressing it shows them.

android.storage_used.note: Screen-reader name of the bar at the foot of the left menu (on a wide screen) that shows how full the device's storage is. {percent} is a number already formatted (45 or 45.68). Write the percent sign as your language does.

android.time_days_ago.note: How long ago something happened, in days, in the Social feed, the alerts and Settings > Shared Links. Keep it as short as the English (d for days).

android.time_hours_ago.note: How long ago something happened, in hours, in the Social feed, the alerts and Settings > Shared Links. Keep it as short as the English (h for hours).

android.time_just_now.note: When something happened less than a minute ago, in the Social feed, the alerts and Settings > Shared Links (after last there, hence the lowercase start).

android.time_minutes_ago.note: How long ago something happened, in minutes, in the Social feed, the alerts and Settings > Shared Links. Keep it as short as the English (m for minutes).

android.ws_connect_timeout.text: The device didn't answer the connection in time
android.ws_connect_timeout.note: Error given to an action when the connection to the device couldn't be opened in time (nothing answered at its address).

android.ws_still_connecting.note: Error given to an action whose time ran out while the app was still connecting to the device.

android.ws_timed_out.text: The device did not answer in time
android.ws_timed_out.note: Error given to an action (and shown on the card shown over the app when connecting fails) when the device didn't answer a request in time.
